title: Approval of an Open Drug Coverage Request on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan
content:
Where an open drug coverage request on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is to be approved, the plan records the approval and fixes the run of days for which it holds good and the last day it stays good for. The member's coverage determination record gains an approval for the named product, the pharmacy may then dispense it, and the member is sent the approval notice.

## Recording the approval

The approval is recorded with `issue_exception_decision_dd13544d`, a tool the agent unlocks and then calls.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdp_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the stand-alone Part D drug plan enrollment the request was made under, read from the member's enrollment record | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member reference number of the person the request concerns, read from their member profile | an identifier |
| `pdp_determination_id` | the reference number of the open drug coverage request this approval disposes of, read from the member's coverage determination records | an identifier |
| `national_drug_code` | the product the approval covers, copied from the request being approved | written in the schema's own form of an eleven-digit National Drug Code, no dashes and no spaces either; never left empty |
| `approval_term_days` | the run for which the approval holds good, as a whole number of calendar days counted from the day this approval is given | an integer with no decimal part and no unit suffix; never left empty and never zero or negative |

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the new decision record's reference number, the drug plan enrollment reference number, the National Drug Code approved, the run in days the approval holds good for, and the last day it stays good for as YYYY-MM-DD. A sentence of this shape means the approval is on the member's record; any other text means no approval was recorded.
